Package se.idkollen.client.models

Class AgeVerificationRequest

java.lang.Object
se.idkollen.client.models.AgeVerificationRequest
public class AgeVerificationRequest extends Object
Request body for starting an age verification session.

At least one of minAge or maxAge must be set.
